verdict.rationale: The README offers several no-compile install paths: pre-built binaries on the GitHub releases page, Docker images with dedicated docs, a Winget package, and an installer at llama.app. A hands-on report confirms the official release binaries are used in practice, though macOS users had to remove the quarantine attribute before they would run. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on installation for each platform and package manager beyond brief README mentions, and a smoother macOS binary experience without the quarantine workaround.
